page.overview:
Who is Aledrin Malenry?

Aledrin Malenry is an Aes Sedai and for a while a Sitter of the White Ajah in the Rebel Hall of the Tower.

She has dark golden hair, worn in a net instead of the typical Taraboner braids, and liquid brown eyes. She is very plump and has a dress with wide white sleeves and a snowy panel on the front that accentuates her berth . Egwene thinks that she is quite lovely when she smiles, though Romanda thinks that she falls short of pretty but she has a good head on her shoulders.

As an Accepted, she was considered excitable. This seems to have changed by the time she became Aes Sedai. Though an exemplar of White logic, she also has a degree of practicality and worldliness foreign to most Whites. These may have weighed against her becoming a Sitter any other time, but these were considered useful qualities for a Rebel Sitter.

Aledrin is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.
